name: Saihate Eki - Tasogare Dentetsu
source:
"But what exactly is true happiness?"

The two had sworn to escape from everything and spend eternity in paradise.

However, after a long, long time had passed, the train suddenly began to move once again...

This is an exploration horror adventure with a new map and scenario -  the additional content for Saihate Station.

You control Tatsunami Shion. As you travel by train through a ruined station bathed in the sunset, you unravel the past and go in search for true happiness.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3216040]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“但真正的幸福到底是什么？”

两人发誓要逃离一切，在天堂里度过永恒。

然而，过了很久很久之后，火车突然又开始行驶了……

这是一场带有新地图和场景的探索恐怖冒险——Saihate Station的附加内容。

你控制辰波紫苑。当你乘坐火车穿过沐浴在夕阳下的废墟车站时，你将解开过去并寻找真正的幸福。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3216040]Steam[/url]]
